Jaxson Dart just nailed it. Watch this. Guy’s going to have the number one selling jersey in America by the end of the month. Fun fact: New York was closer to being a red state in 2024 than Florida or Texas were to being blue.

Final thought and an easy analogy to follow, if you want to put a political bumper sticker on your car, fine, but if you show up and put a political bumper sticker on a FedEx or UPS truck you’re paid to drive, you’d get fired. That’s the right move. Same with sports.

Several things: 1. Everyone should be able to do whatever they want in their outside work life when it comes to politics. Share your opinions, advocate for whomever you like. 2. When you do politics in your uniform at work, it’s a bad look for athletes in my opinion. It only alienates fans. 3.
